changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN FOR r IN SELECT c.conrelid::regclass AS tbl, c.conname FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.contype = 'u' AND c.conrelid::regclass::text IN ( 'recording_unit_document', 'specimen_document', 'spatial_unit_document') -- only the single-column constraint on the document, never a composite one AND array_length(c.conkey, 1) = 1 LOOP EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %s DROP CONSTRAINT %I', r.tbl, r.conname); END LOOP; END $$;
